description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Sample Token Count” on the x-axis and the “Shared Experts for Two Samples” on the y-axis, across six distinct task categories: Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, and Math. The x-axis is logarithmically scaled, ranging from $2^9$ (512) to $2^{20}$ (1,048,576) tokens, with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with major ticks every 0.5 units. Each task is represented by a uniquely colored line with no markers: Intent (orange-red), Summary (blue), Law (golden-yellow), Translation (purple), Code (gray), and Math (green). The “Code” line starts at approximately 1.95 at $2^9$, dips slightly, then rises steadily to about 5.75 at $2^{20}$, with a notable dip around $2^{14}$. The “Summary” line begins near 2.0, rises sharply to ~5.8 by $2^{17}$, then plateaus. The “Translation” line starts at ~5.1, dips to ~4.7 at $2^{11}$, then climbs to ~5.9 by $2^{17}$ and stabilizes. The “Law” line begins at ~3.6, peaks at ~5.7 at $2^{13}$, dips to ~4.6 at $2^{14}$, then recovers to ~5.9. The “Intent” line starts at ~3.8, dips to ~3.9 at $2^{11}$, then climbs to ~5.9. The “Math” line begins at ~3.8, rises steadily to ~5.9 by $2^{18}$, then slightly declines to ~5.85. All lines except “Code” converge near the top of the y-axis (5.8–6.0) at higher token counts, indicating increasing expert sharing as sample size grows.
